meta.name: design-doctrine
meta.description: The house rules for ANY design or UI work - the verification protocol (run the gate, never claim a number), the absolute no-emoji rule, token by intent, one shared theme, the eight states, one thing leads, and output completeness. Load this FIRST whenever building, reviewing, or theming a screen, component, or token set. Installed as a plugin, this skill carries what CLAUDE.md carries in the repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面设计与评审统一到同一套规则,按流程逐项验收
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果多人一起做界面,总在配色、状态和文案上各做各的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep every interface build and review on one shared rule set, verified step by step
copy.fit_line_en: For you if several people build UI and keep diverging on color, states, and copy.

howto.what: 做任何界面、组件或设计令牌相关工作前,Claude 会先读这套规则:输出前跑校验脚本并报告真实数字,全程禁止 emoji,交互元素补齐八种状态,并交付完整文件而非占位符。
howto.when: 当你要求构建、审查界面或组件,或给令牌集、主题做设计时最先接管;配色、排版、可访问性、品牌等设计工作也走它。

say.text: 把这个按钮的默认、hover、focus 状态跑一遍校验
say.note: 会运行状态校验脚本并报告真实结果

say.text: 用这套令牌给这个页面配深色主题
say.note: 只从 tokens 走同一套变量层

say.text: 检查这个组件有没有违反禁 emoji 和意图令牌规则

howto.what_en: Before any UI, component, or token work, Claude reads these house rules: it runs the gate scripts and reports real numbers, bans emoji in all output, ships all eight interactive states, and delivers full files instead of placeholders.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build, review, or theme a screen, component, or token set, and for design work such as colour, typography, accessibility, or brand rules.

say_en.text: Run the state gate on this button's default, hover, and focus states
say_en.note: Runs the state script and reports real output

say_en.text: Theme this page for dark mode using the shared tokens
say_en.note: Renders from tokens via one variable layer

say_en.text: Check this component against the no-emoji and token-by-intent rules
